package consumer

import "github.com/progresshans/godj/api/parameters"

type queryDTO struct { Page int64; Search *string; Token string }

func typedQuery(raw string) (queryDTO, error) {
	query, err := parameters.New(2048,
		parameters.Field("page", parameters.Default(parameters.CanonicalInt64(1, 100), 1), func(row *queryDTO, value int64) { row.Page = value }, "Page."),
		parameters.Field("search", parameters.Optional(parameters.String(64, true)), func(row *queryDTO, value *string) { row.Search = value }, "Search."),
		parameters.Field("token", parameters.Required(parameters.String(32, false)), func(row *queryDTO, value string) { row.Token = value }, "Token."),
	)
	if err != nil { return queryDTO{}, err }
	_ = query.Parameters()
	value, violations, err := query.Parse(raw)
	if !violations.Empty() { return queryDTO{}, nil }
	return value, err
}
